subject: Action-Angle Networks kickoff - physics surrogates that respect structure
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Action-Angle Networks evaluation. Scientific-computing prospects keep telling us generic neural surrogates drift on long rollouts because they ignore the physics. Our open-source JAX implementation attacks this by learning dynamics in action-angle coordinates, where the structure of integrable motion is built in rather than hoped for.

What I like operationally: the whole thing is config-driven via ml_collections config_flags - training runs from main.py with a config like configs/action_angle_flow.py, and hyperparameters (num_train_steps, batch_size) override from the command line. That makes systematic benchmarking cheap.

Plan for the window: repro of the paper's systems by March 27; a long-horizon rollout benchmark versus two baseline surrogate families in May; go/no-go on a customer pilot at the June 1 review.

Deshawn - staffing note and compute ask when you can. This is small-compute, the leverage is in careful evaluation.

Anders
